ammonia.reason: Very low deamination after 1 mo; no surface flora to release NH3.

animal_barnyard.reason: Raw mountain milk p-cresol and stable notes kept low by short aging.

bitter.reason: Limited proteolysis to hydrophobic peptides; starter peptidases clear bitterness.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti and no methyl ketone pathway.

browning.reason: Lactose plus lysine Maillard at pH 5.78 gives moderate browning on heating.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl and acetoin from Lactococcus citrate fermentation in young moist curd.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Short ripening limits lipase release of butyric and hexanoic acids.

creaminess.reason: Full-fat 29.7% fat and 38.6% moisture lubricate; milkfat coats palate.

crumbliness.reason: Young rennet gel with hydrated para-casein fractures little; not crumbly.

firmness.reason: Semi-cooked pressed curd at 38.6% moisture gives elastic semi-hard body.

floral_honey.reason: Pasture terpenes and phenylethanol retained from raw milk, low concentration.

fruity.reason: Little esterase time to form ethyl butanoate and ethyl hexanoate.

goaty.reason: Cow milk low in caproic-caprylic acids and 4-ethyloctanoic acid.

malty_nutty.reason: Early Strecker 2-methylpropanal and 3-methylbutanal; no extensive aged nuttiness.

melt.reason: pH 5.78 calcium-phosphate crosslinked casein still flows when heated.

mushroom_earthy.reason: No bloomy or washed rind; no 1-octen-3-ol from mold lipoxygenase.

oil_off.reason: 29.7% milkfat coalesces moderately on melting without heavy oiling.

smoky.reason: Unsmoked; no guaiacol or phenols from smoke exposure.

sour_vinegar.reason: Lactic acid from mesophilic starters buffered to pH 5.78, mild acidity.

stretch.reason: Rennet-coagulated non-pasta-filata; no hot-water kneaded aligned fibers.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Semi-cooking denatures whey protein slightly; minimal H2S and methional.

sweet.reason: Residual lactose and diacetyl plus low acid and bitter, milky-sweet impression.

umami.reason: Short proteolysis yields little free glutamate; no MSG-like depth.
